## The Great Gatsby — Florine Stettheimer (2 November 2026)

The Cathedrals of Fifth Avenue, 1931, oil on canvas, Metropolitan Museum of Art, 53.24.4. Museum record: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/488735

User-approved replacement for Bellows. Level 2: high society, marriage, luxury and conspicuous consumption, as discussed by the museum. It is not an illustration of Gatsby or Daisy. Full original 3083 × 3712 pixels retained unchanged; CSS position center 70% keeps the wedding and luxury details in the card.

Specific reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Cathedrals_of_Fifth_Avenue_MET_DT11557.jpg . The page identifies a donation from the Met and CC0 1.0, including CC0 in the file metadata; original upload 25 March 2017, 3.32 MB. Artist died in 1944; the ordinary life-plus-70 term has elapsed in Italy/EU. Do not infer a universal licence from the current museum page: it restricts image downloads. The source selected here is the specific Commons file with its documented dedication. Source file: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3b/The_Cathedrals_of_Fifth_Avenue_MET_DT11557.jpg . Licence deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ .

The catalogue credit contains only artist, linked artwork title and year. Old Bellows file retained as archive. No change to Holden or other books.
